name: sanctorum
description: Sanctorum — a pixel office of agents
author: Sanctorum

scripts.dev:frontend: wait-on tcp:3001 && npm --prefix frontend run dev
scripts.dev:ai: cd aiservice && uv run python -m sanctorum_aiservice.api.main
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm run install:ai
scripts.// desktop: Desktop mode: Next.js only; Electron spawns backend + aiservice itself
scripts.dev:electron: concurrently -n next,electron -c cyan,yellow --kill-others "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "npm:electron:start"
scripts.electron:start: npm run build:electron && wait-on tcp:3000 && electron dist-electron/main.js
scripts.// build: npx electron-builder --win | --mac | --linux | --dir  (assumes the builds below already ran)
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend && npm run build:electron && npm run build:aiservice
scripts.pack: npm run build:desktop && npm run seed:db && electron-builder --dir
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:desktop && npm run seed:db && electron-builder --win
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build:desktop && npm run seed:db && electron-builder --mac
scripts.prisma:migrate: npm --prefix backend exec -- prisma migrate dev
scripts.build:aiservice: cd aiservice && uv run pyinstaller aiservice.spec --noconfirm
